seat_4_reproduction.command_difference: --games 16 --model-seat 4, with the same seed window and all other settings unchanged

decision: The frozen routed v6 five-player expert is not promoted as a strong universal procedural agent. Its 17 wins across 80 games barely differ from 16 baseline greedy wins, with eight paired improvements versus seven regressions; the weakest seat ties greedy at one win in 16 maps. The fixed-duel Elo ladder is a different pool and cannot be extrapolated to this domain.
limitations: This is one 16-map CPU scout, not a high-confidence strength gate or an absolute human Elo. The same v1 five-player expert was explicitly routed into v2 maps to avoid silently falling back to the bundle's profile-level expert. All-seat outcomes reuse maps across five seat assignments, so those games are correlated.
